deanMessage.label: About us
deanMessage.title: Dean's message
deanMessage.imageAlt: Dean of the Faculty of Computer and Data Science
deanMessage.paragraph1: Data science now shapes work across many fields. Alexandria University created the Faculty of Computer and Data Science to teach these subjects with clear, practical programs.
deanMessage.paragraph2: Our programs cover business analytics, intelligent systems, media analytics, healthcare informatics, and cybersecurity. We invite students who want to study computing and data at Alexandria University to join the faculty.
deanMessage.name: Prof. Dr. Faculty Dean
deanMessage.position: Dean of the Faculty of Computer and Data Science
